description: Machine-readable inventory of Statskontoret open datasets used by Riksdagsmonitor for Swedish government-body and central-government budget context. Complements IMF (primary economic projections), SCB (Swedish official statistics), World Bank (non-economic global context), and Riksdag/Regering data.

clients.cli: tsx scripts/statskontoret-fetch.ts (commands: list-sources, discover, headcount, budget-outturn)

notes.noMcp: Statskontoret is not an MCP server. Agentic workflows invoke the TypeScript CLI via the bash tool, mirroring IMF's no-MCP client pattern.
notes.formats: Myndighetsförteckningen is published as Excel. Årsutfall and Månadsutfall expose both Excel and CSV ZIP downloads. Budget time-series pages link to annual official-statistics publications and related open-data tables.
notes.privacy: Public authority/agency data and aggregate budget data only; no private-person data. Authority names and agency-level budget lines are public administrative records.

myndighetsforteckning.title: Myndighetsförteckning – öppna data
myndighetsforteckning.cadence: Annual snapshot; source page metadata observed as last-modified 2026-02-06 for the 2025 workbook.
myndighetsforteckning.primaryUse: Headcount of government bodies, grouped by department, leadership form and special organs; department headcount over time from 2007 onward.

derivedArtifacts.description: Sum årsarbetskrafter by year and department, with authority count per group.

budget-time-series.title: Tidsserier, statens budget m.m.
budget-time-series.coverage: Final outcomes for central-government revenue, expenditure, balance and related public-finance tables, generally from 1995.
budget-time-series.primaryUse: Long-run Swedish central-government budget context for finance, tax and public-administration analysis.

derivedArtifacts.description: Long-run central-government budget time series (revenue and expenditure) from 1995 onward parsed into StatskontoretBudgetRow objects.

arsutfall.title: Årsutfall för statens budget – öppna data
arsutfall.cadence: Annual, with preliminary and definitive releases.
arsutfall.coverage: Annual revenue and expenditure outturns based on Hermes reporting, Riksdag budget decisions and government disposition rights.
arsutfall.primaryUse: Annual budget execution by appropriation, income title and agency; definitive vs preliminary status tracking.

derivedArtifacts.description: Annual central-government revenue outturn rows (documentType=Inkomst) parsed into StatskontoretBudgetRow objects.
Annual central-government expenditure outturn rows (documentType=Utgift) parsed into StatskontoretBudgetRow objects.

manadsutfall.title: Månadsutfall för statens budget – öppna data
manadsutfall.coverage: Monthly revenue and expenditure outcomes from January 2006 onward, specified at income-subtitle / appropriation-item / agency granularity.
manadsutfall.primaryUse: High-frequency budget execution monitoring and agency-level spending/revenue context.

derivedArtifacts.description: Monthly central-government revenue outturn rows (documentType=Inkomst) parsed into StatskontoretBudgetRow objects.
Monthly central-government expenditure outturn rows (documentType=Utgift) parsed into StatskontoretBudgetRow objects.

updateDiscipline.myndighetsforteckning: Check annually and whenever the source page last-modified value changes.
updateDiscipline.budgetOutturn: Check monthly for Månadsutfall and annually/preliminary cycles for Årsutfall.
updateDiscipline.integrity: Persist raw source payload plus .meta.json provenance; review derived headcount diffs in PRs.
